comments.text:
The standalone binary crashes on macOS with a null pointer dereference in baseview::macos::view::become_first_responder (view.rs:248). This happens during NSView initialization when viewWillMoveToWindow is called.

Stack trace: baseview::macos::view::become_first_responder → view_will_move_to_window → NSWindow.setContentView → Window::open_blocking → standalone wrapper.

Additionally, CoreAudio sends more samples than the configured buffer size (558 vs 512, 1115 vs 1024) causing a panic in cpal.rs:832. This may be a sample rate mismatch issue (44100 vs 48000).

Both issues are in upstream dependencies (baseview 579130e, nih-plug 28b149ec). Options:
1. Report upstream to nih-plug/baseview
2. Try a different nih-plug/baseview revision
3. Use the JACK backend instead of CoreAudio (requires JACK installed)
4. Build a custom standalone wrapper using winit/baseview directly instead of nih-plug standalone

macOS version: Darwin 25.4.0

title: fix(vst): investigate baseview null pointer crash in standalone mode on macOS
